# Plugin SDK Coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/sdk-coverage.php from docs/sdk-coverage/coverage.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

How far a plugin can read, change, react to and extend each part of Whity core through the plugin SDK, as of SDK 1.174.0 and core 0.2.32 (2026-11-25). Of 56 areas, 15 are full, 32 partial and 9 none.

- **Full**: A plugin can read, change, react to and extend this area through a published SDK contract.
- **Partial**: Some of it is in the SDK; the rest is missing or reachable only through internal core classes.
- **None**: No SDK contract. A plugin cannot interact with this area in a supported way.

Areas marked **Needs a design** have gaps that could cross workspaces, skip permissions or move money, so they get a design before an SDK export. Every SDK minor updates this matrix in the same pull request; CI checks it against the SDK changelog, `sdk/CHANGELOG.md`.

## People and access

<a id="users"></a>

### Users and accounts: Partial

**In the SDK**

- user.creating, user.created, user.updated, user.deleted hook events (SDK 1.0)
- user.creating is read-only and can refuse an admin create with HookVetoException (SDK 1.70)

**Missing**

- A user directory and membership reader
- A supported way to provision or update users
- user.updating and a user.deleting veto
- Creation events on self-registration, invitation acceptance and SSO provisioning (only admin create fires them)
- Custom profile fields
- A slot on the user record page

**Needs a design.** Hooks on account creation must not expose credentials or let a listener change the role. A read-only notification payload and a narrow, audited mutation contract are needed rather than more filter hooks.

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="people-directory"></a>

### People directory: None

**Missing**

- A person read and search contract
- person.* events
- Custom person fields
- A person picker block

**Needs a design.** People records are personal data. A reader must be pinned to the current workspace, checked against relations:read for the caller, and able to redact fields.

Planned: later.

<a id="contacts"></a>

### Contacts (customers and suppliers): Partial

**In the SDK**

- Setup\WorkspaceSetup: list and add contacts through core routes, as the acting person (for packs) (SDK 1.110)
- Contacts\Contacts host service: list, get, find by a custom field, create and update contacts without HTTP, writes acting as a person with contacts:write (SDK 1.119)
- PluginContactFieldsInterface: a plugin's own fields on contacts, named under the plugin, made where it is on and archived with values kept where it is off (SDK 1.119)
- $ctx->contacts() (Contacts\WorkspaceContacts): the same reads and writes in the workspace the call runs in, with no workspace argument; also $ctx->timeOff(), away() and bookings(). Every contribution point also has its 2.0 name under Contribute\ (SDK 1.161)

**Missing**

- contact.created and contact.updated events
- Archiving a contact from a plugin
- A contact picker block

**Needs a design.** Contacts are personal data. Reads are trusted to the plugin; writes check the acting person's permissions like the routes do.

Planned: later.

<a id="authentication"></a>

### Sign-in, SSO and two-factor: None

**In the SDK**

- ExternalAuthProvider and ExternalIdentity types (not yet wired to a registration path) (host)
- IssuerTokenVerifier, JwsVerifier and JwksCache: verify Whity ID (or any one issuer's) tokens against its key set (SDK 1.106)

**Missing**

- Registering a plugin identity provider
- Read-only sign-in, sign-out, two-factor and password-reset events
- Custom second factors
- Password policy extension

**Needs a design.** An identity provider decides who an account belongs to. It needs a trust tier, operator-only enablement and binding per workspace. Sign-in events must be observe-only so no plugin can capture credentials or block sign-in.

Planned: later.

<a id="tenants"></a>

### Workspaces: Partial

**In the SDK**

- tenant.creating to tenant.deleted hook events (SDK 1.0)
- Veto a workspace deletion inside its transaction (SDK 1.15)
- Owned tables cascade on workspace deletion (PluginTablesInterface) (SDK 1.20)
- workspace.owner_added, workspace.owner_removed and workspace.ownership_transferred when a workspace changes hands or gains or loses a co-owner (SDK 1.112)
- tenant.handle_changed when a workspace's @handle changes (SDK 1.160)

**Missing**

- A workspace read contract (name, plan, locale, enabled plugins)
- Workspace custom fields
- A slot on workspace settings

**Needs a design.** Install-wide plugins see every workspace's events. Hook subscriptions scoped to a workspace need a design before more workspace data is exposed.

Planned: later.

<a id="rbac"></a>

### Roles and permissions: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Route requiredPermission enforced by the host (SDK 1.2)
- PermissionResolver: read-only permission checks (SDK 1.16)
- Permission checks scoped to one record (SDK 1.17)
- Plugin-declared resource types (SDK 1.18)
- Role checks scoped to one record (SDK 1.22)
- ResourceScope: which records of a plugin resource type a caller may act on (narrowing only) (SDK 1.74)
- Declared permissions and seeded roles (PluginRolesInterface) (SDK 1.0)
- Role grants limited to the plugin's own permissions and roles, removed only by the plugin that made them (SDK 1.72)
- Customer-grade permissions (PluginCustomerPermissionsInterface): the plugin's own permissions that reach only the caller's records, which customers may hold and sign-up roles may include (SDK 1.104)
- Core permissions for the plugin's roles, asked for with Contribute\CorePermissionRequestsInterface and granted only when an operator approves them per role and workspace; Contribute\CorePermissionGrants says whether a grant is in place (SDK 1.130)

**Missing**

- Granting and revoking record-level roles through a contract
- Events when a role's permissions change, and a veto on grants
- Roles namespaced to the plugin

**Needs a design.** Anything that grants authority can escalate privilege. Role seeding and grants must be limited to the plugin's own roles and permissions, and every check must be bound to the caller's workspace by the host.

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="delegations"></a>

### Delegations: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Delegation\Away::at(): whether a person is away at a moment (their "I'm away" period or time off) and who stands in for them, with what is handed over; the plugins cover lets a plugin's own approvals follow the stand-in (SDK 1.120)

**Missing**

- The acting-for context of a request made by a stand-in
- Delegation events
- A veto on delegating a plugin-owned permission

**Needs a design.** Delegation transfers authority, so plugins may observe and refuse it but must never create it.

Planned: later.

<a id="groups-audiences"></a>

### User groups and audiences: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Plugin rule kinds in groups and routing (RoutingRuleResolverInterface) (SDK 1.37)
- Audience rule vocabulary shared with groups (SDK 1.38)

**Missing**

- Resolving a group's or audience's members
- Group events
- A group picker block

**Needs a design.** A plugin rule resolver returns people for a workspace. The host must drop anyone who is not an active member of that workspace rather than trusting the resolver.

Planned: later.

<a id="ous"></a>

### Organizational units: Full

**In the SDK**

- ou.* hook events, including role assignment and a delete veto (SDK 1.0)
- Plugin OU types an admin adopts (SDK 1.30)
- ouScopePicker block (SDK 1.32)

**Missing**

- A server-side OU tree reader
- OU custom fields

Planned: later.

<a id="invitations-registration"></a>

### Invitations and registration: Partial

**In the SDK**

- membership.customer_joined when somebody joins a workspace through its own customer sign-up (SDK 1.73)
- Constants for registration.completed, registration.approved and registration.rejected (SDK 1.89)
- membership.customer_inviting: refuse or annotate a customer's team invitation; membership.customer_joined with via invitation, the inviter and the annotations (SDK 1.105)

**Missing**

- Events for invitations staff send
- Custom registration fields
- An accept-or-reject check on registration

**Needs a design.** A registration check may accept or reject, never set the role or unit, or it becomes an escalation path.

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="relations"></a>

### Relations: None

**Missing**

- Plugin relationship types
- Reading and writing relations
- Relation events

**Needs a design.** Relations hold family and guardian links. Writes need permission-checked contracts.

Planned: later.

<a id="tags"></a>

### Tags and taxonomy: None

**Missing**

- Declared taggable types and vocabularies
- Reading and attaching tags
- A tag picker block
- Tag events

Planned: 0.2.28. Tracked in [#714](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/714).

<a id="calendar"></a>

### Calendar and bookings: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Booking payment step (PluginBookingPaymentInterface, Calendar\BookingPaymentStep): require a payment such as a deposit before a booking is confirmed; core holds the slot as pending_payment and the plugin settles it through the Calendar\Bookings host service (SDK 1.98)
- Busy times from outside core (PluginCalendarBusyInterface): read when free times are listed and again inside the lock before a booking is written; failures fail open (SDK 1.98)
- Calendar\CalendarEvents host service: keep events from an outside calendar on a person's calendar, keyed by the plugin's own reference (SDK 1.98)
- calendar.event.created|updated|deleted and booking.created|confirmed|rescheduled|cancelled|expired events with ids only (SDK 1.98)
- Setup\WorkspaceSetup: set up booking rules, services, staff and hours through core routes, as the acting person (for packs) (SDK 1.108)
- PluginWorkspaceTemplatesInterface: ready starts for one kind of business, offered after a workspace is created and applied by core as the person choosing them (SDK 1.116)
- A workspace template names its theme (`theme`), offered when the template is chosen (SDK 1.131)
- A workspace template turns on the walk-in queue (`calendar.settings.walkins_enabled`) and may give a role `calendar:front_desk` (SDK 1.147)
- Workspace templates: the apply engine (Templates\TemplateEngine), a dry run that changes nothing (Templates\DryRunWorkspaceSetup, the preview route), the version of each part a run applied, and a test kit for template authors (Testing\WorkspaceTemplateTestCase, Testing\FakeWorkspace) (SDK 1.169)
- Workspace templates build on each other (`extends`, `remove`, `hidesParent`; Templates\TemplateComposer), other plugins add pieces to them (Contribute\PluginWorkspaceTemplateExtensionsInterface), plugin.json declares them as files (`workspaceTemplates`, `workspaceTemplateExtensions`), and a new version is offered item by item (`changes`, Use the template's version) (SDK 1.170)
- A workspace template's `pipelines` become review routes in Flows for its forms: one decision stage per stage, for the people holding one of the template's roles, attached to a form that has no route yet (SDK 1.172)
- WorkspaceCommissionExpenses (Contribute): book a closed commission period (CommissionClose) as an expense; event calendar.commission.closed (SDK 1.148)
- PluginDisplayNameInterface: the name people read for a plugin, in English and Arabic (SDK 1.117)
- Calendar\TimeOff host service: create, cancel and list a person's time off as the acting person, idempotent by the plugin's own reference (SDK 1.120)

**Missing**

- Reading a person's bookings and services from a plugin
- Locations and resources (rooms, equipment)
- A slot on the booking page for plugin fields

**Needs a design.** A payment step and a sync plugin act only for the workspace they are called for, through host services that re-apply it; they never write calendar tables. Core never takes card details.

Planned: 0.2.28. Tracked in [#1815](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1815).

## Documents

<a id="documents"></a>

### Documents: Partial

**In the SDK**

- documentViewer block (SDK 1.36)
- document.issuing (veto and checks), document.issued, document.rendered events (SDK 1.49)
- Issue documents as the person (Documents::issue) (SDK 1.56)
- Issue in the background where the workspace allows it (SDK 1.58)
- PluginDocumentStore, QR verification links and tracking (SDK 1.63)
- Document numbering rules and document.numbered (SDK 1.65)
- Preflight an issue without writing (SDK 1.66)
- document.revised (SDK 1.68)
- Issue in bulk from one template as a background job (Documents::issueMany) (SDK 1.83)
- Issue events for documents raised by form submissions (SDK 1.94)
- Published constants for document.routed and document.route_acted (SDK 1.94)
- route.sent_back, route.resubmitted, route.completed, route.signed and document.finalised events (SDK 1.94)
- route.stamped event: a holder applied a company stamp on a stamp step (SDK 1.153)
- Blocks a plugin adds to the document editor, drawn by Whity's renderer (documents.blocks, PluginDocumentBlocksInterface) (SDK 1.103)

**Missing**

- Reading and listing documents other than the plugin's own
- Withdraw and revise contracts, and document.withdrawn
- Embed record providers and chart sources
- Collections and organizer views

**Needs a design.** Document visibility depends on the caller and the route. A reader must apply the host's visibility policy per caller, and withdraw or revise must keep the audit trail intact.

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="templates-editor"></a>

### Templates, themes and the editor: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Template slots in plugin.json (SDK 1.55)
- Template slots and merge-field providers for code plugins (SDK 1.56)
- Starter templates shipped by a plugin, seeded per workspace (SDK 1.81)
- Read published templates and their merge fields (Templates) (SDK 1.82)

**Missing**

- Plugin document themes
- Editor blocks, toolbar items and slash-menu entries
- Template and theme events

**Needs a design.** Merge fields and editor blocks end up in printed, immutable documents. Providers must be held to the caller's workspace and permissions by the host, and plugin block markup needs a sandbox and server-side schema checks.

Planned: later.

<a id="render"></a>

### Render service: Partial

**In the SDK**

- DocumentRenderer, FlowDocument, PageSpec (SDK 1.41)
- Inline runs in flowing text (SDK 1.44)
- Render and issue from queue jobs and CLI commands (SDK 1.76)
- QR codes as SVG or a data URI for a printout, without a vendor package (Print\QrCode) (SDK 1.111)

**Missing**

- Choosing a theme or brand when rendering
- Rendering from a workspace template outside Documents::issue

**Needs a design.** HTML or CSS input to the renderer would be an injection and server-side request surface. Keep input structured.

Planned: 0.2.28. Tracked in [#1151](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1151).

<a id="routing"></a>

### Routing and approvals: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Plugin routing rules that resolve recipients (SDK 1.37)

**Missing**

- Reading a document's route and trail
- Starting or acting on a route
- Plugin route effects
- route.completed, step-due events and a veto before an action

**Needs a design.** Acting on a route is an approval on a person's behalf. It needs the actor bound by the host and the agent proposal policy.

Planned: later.

## Forms and workflow

<a id="accounting"></a>

### Accounting: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Accounting\Accounts host service: the chart of accounts in tree order, by code and by role (receivable, sales tax, stock...), and accounts a plugin owns added through $ctx->accounting()->accounts(); the container copy only reads (SDK 1.154)
- Accounting\Ledger: the append-only double-entry ledger, hash-chained per workspace; plugins post balanced entries in an open month and reverse them through $ctx->accounting()->ledger(), bound to the loaded plugin (idempotent by key), acting as a person with accounting:post; reads entries and balances (SDK 1.154)
- Accounting\Periods and Accounting\Reports: whether a date is open, the lock date, and the trial balance (SDK 1.154)
- Events accounting.entry.posting (filter, can veto), accounting.entry.posted, accounting.entry.reversed, accounting.period.closed and accounting.period.reopened (SDK 1.154)
- PluginContext: $ctx->accounting() (Context\AccountingScope) with accounts(), ledger(), periods() and reports() (SDK 1.154)
- Accounting\Invoices: sales invoices and credit notes, drafted, issued (numbered, frozen and posted, or sent for approval), credited and read; through $ctx->accounting()->invoices() they belong to the plugin and external references are kept under its name; the container copy only reads (SDK 1.155)
- Accounting\Taxes: the workspace's tax codes, the code for an item's tax category on a date, and a line's net and tax (SDK 1.155)
- Contribute\WorkspaceEInvoicing: one connector bound in the container reports issued invoices and credit notes to a tax authority (JoFotara first) and writes back its reference, QR and status (SDK 1.155)
- Events accounting.invoice.issuing (filter, can veto), accounting.invoice.issued and accounting.invoice.credited (SDK 1.155)
- Accounting\Payments: payments received (posted at once, settling invoices, a provider's fee to fees), allocations and transfers between the workspace's own accounts; through $ctx->accounting()->payments() they belong to the plugin and external references are kept under its name (Whity Pay records here); the container copy only reads (SDK 1.156)
- Events accounting.payment.recorded, accounting.payment.allocated, accounting.invoice.paid, accounting.invoice.partly_paid and accounting.cheque.bounced (SDK 1.156)
- Supplier bills and supplier credits through Accounting\Invoices (kind purchase, acting with bills:write) and Accounting\Payments::recordMade() for money paid to suppliers (SDK 1.157)
- Events accounting.bill.posting (filter, can veto), accounting.bill.posted and accounting.bill.paid (SDK 1.157)
- Expense claims: Invoice::$claimantProfileId on a claim (a bill from the person who paid) and the accounting.expense.claimed event (SDK 1.158)
- Stock in the books: core accounting implements Contribute\WorkspaceAccountingExport and posts each stock batch to the stock journal, on by default with a switch (SDK 1.159)

**Missing**

- Filing expense claims and petty cash spends through the SDK (API-only); bills matched to stock receipts (A4); cheques through the SDK (deposit and bounce are API-only)
- Aged receivables and the customer statement through Reports (API-only until A5)
- Profit and loss, balance sheet and aged reports (A5)
- Tax packs, bank feeds, currency rates and reports as extension points (A6, A7)

**Needs a design.** The books are financial records. Reads are trusted to the plugin; writes check the acting person's permissions like the routes do, and every entry names its plugin.

Planned: later.

<a id="inventory"></a>

### Inventory and stock: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Inventory\Items host service: list, get, find by SKU or barcode, create, update and archive items with variants, units and barcodes, writes acting as a person with inventory:write and counted toward inventory.items.max, which only warns (SDK 1.127)
- Inventory\Locations host service: real places and the virtual ones (supplier, customer, loss, found, production, consumed, opening, transit) (SDK 1.127)
- Inventory\Stock: levels, available and the append-only ledger; plugins post and undo moves through $ctx->inventory()->stock(), bound to the loaded plugin (idempotent by key); the container copy only reads (SDK 1.127)
- Inventory\Units and Inventory\Quantity: exact unit conversions and quantities as whole steps, never floats (SDK 1.127)
- Events stock.moving (filter, can veto), stock.moved, inventory.item.created, updated and archived (SDK 1.127)
- PluginContext: $ctx->inventory() (Context\InventoryScope) with items(), locations(), stock() and units() (SDK 1.127)
- Inventory\Operations: adjustments with the workspace's reasons, counts (expected taken per line, blind optional) and transfers (sent, on the way, received), through $ctx->inventory()->operations(), bound to the loaded plugin; the container copy only reads (SDK 1.128)
- Approval above the workspace's value: an adjustment or a count's differences travel their route (inventory.adjustment, inventory.count) before posting (SDK 1.128)
- Events inventory.operation.done, inventory.count.differences, stock.level.below_reorder and stock.level.restored (SDK 1.128)
- Inventory\Orders: purchase orders for a supplier contact, sent on the workspace's purchase route (or approved at once) and received in parts at the order's cost, through $ctx->inventory()->orders(), bound to the loaded plugin; the container copy only reads (SDK 1.129)
- Events inventory.order.submitting (filter, can veto) and inventory.order.created, approved, rejected, partly_done, done and cancelled (SDK 1.129)
- Inventory\Lots: batches and serial numbers with their expiry and what each holds where, and what is expiring, through $ctx->inventory()->lots(); MoveLine names a batch (lotId, lotCode, expiresOn, madeOn), and stock leaving without one takes the batches that expire first (SDK 1.137)
- Events stock.lot.expiring and stock.lot.expired, once per batch (SDK 1.137)
- Contribute\WorkspaceQuoteConversion: what an accepted quote turns into (a sales order, an invoice), read as a Sales\QuoteSnapshot; core's inventory and accounting implement it (SDK 1.132)
- Events sales.quote.sending (filter, can veto) and sales.quote.created, sent, accepted, declined, expired, converted and cancelled (SDK 1.132)
- Contribute\WorkspaceAccountingExport: each posted stock batch, as an Inventory\StockPosting with its moves, places, branches and values at core's moving average cost, goes to the one export bound in the container, inside the stock transaction (core accounting is the default) (SDK 1.159)

**Missing**

- Reorder levels and reasons as SDK services (they are on the API and MCP)
- Sales orders and reservations (P5); supplier prices as an SDK service (they are on the API and MCP)
- Scanning GS1 barcodes and batch labels (P4b)
- A costing-method extension point (FIFO, standard cost): core keeps the moving average only

**Needs a design.** Reads are trusted to the plugin. Writes check the acting person's permissions like the routes do, and a plugin's moves are named by the host, never by the plugin.

Planned: later.

<a id="plugin-forms"></a>

### Plugin forms and public routes: Full

**In the SDK**

- form block and input blocks (SDK 1.8)
- Form preload from the plugin's own GET (dataSource) (SDK 1.40)
- Discriminated sub-forms (variant) (SDK 1.42)
- Anonymous form posts ('public' => 'form', PublicForm) (SDK 1.67)
- Anonymous link reads ('public' => 'read', PublicRead) (SDK 1.69)

**Missing**

- Per-route rate limits beyond the host defaults

Planned: later.

<a id="core-forms"></a>

### Core forms and submissions: Partial

**In the SDK**

- form.submitted, submission.reviewed and submission.withdrawn events (SDK 1.94)

**Missing**

- Reading submissions
- Custom field types, validators and prefill sources
- Mapping a submission to a plugin record
- A slot in the form builder and in submission review

**Needs a design.** Submissions hold personal data and anonymous input. Readers must respect member and reviewer scope, events should carry ids only, and a plugin field type on a public form needs the same gate public forms already have.

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="convening"></a>

### Meetings and decisions: None

**Missing**

- meeting.scheduled, meeting.held and decision.recorded events
- Reading meetings and decisions
- Agenda-item sources and a minutes slot

**Needs a design.** Attendance, quorum and decisions are legal facts. Writes need a host-bound actor and audit.

Planned: later.

<a id="inbox"></a>

### Inbox and Waiting for you: Partial

**In the SDK**

- inbox and timeline blocks for the plugin's own items (SDK 1.31)
- Inbox source contract (InboxSource, KeysetInboxSource, PluginInboxSourcesInterface): plugin sources reach the merged inbox, urgent first then newest, paged by position (SDK 1.97)

**Missing**

- Acting on an inbox item from a plugin

**Needs a design.** Each source must answer only for the caller in the current workspace. The host has to enforce that rather than trust the source.

Planned: 0.2.28. Tracked in [#881](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/881), [#1804](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1804).

<a id="time-windows"></a>

### Time windows: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Plugin window types an admin adopts (SDK 1.39)

**Missing**

- Resolving a date to its window
- window.closing veto, window.closed and window.reopened
- A closed-period guard for plugin records
- A published close-report contract

**Needs a design.** A closed period is a bookkeeping rule. Writes into it need a host-enforced guard.

Planned: later.

<a id="records-automations"></a>

### Workspace records and automations: Full

**In the SDK**

- plugin.json manifest (SDK 1.47)
- Manifest expressions (SDK 1.48)
- Record types (SDK 1.50)
- Record rules, defaults, computed and locked fields (SDK 1.51)
- Automations (SDK 1.53)
- Manifest tests (SDK 1.54)
- issue_document automation step (SDK 1.57)

**Missing**

- send_webhook, ask_approval, wait and call_action steps
- Triggers from core events (form submitted, document issued)
- Record types for code plugins

**Needs a design.** Triggers from another area's events must carry ids and re-read under the run's permissions. send_webhook needs an egress allowlist.

Planned: later.

<a id="data-types"></a>

### Data types: Full

**In the SDK**

- Plugin-owned data types with generic admin screens (SDK 1.20)
- Lifecycle writes and guards (SDK 1.24)

**Missing**

- Lifecycle events (trashed, restored, deleted)
- Data types as document merge fields

Planned: later.

<a id="reports"></a>

### Reports: None

**Missing**

- A report source contract
- Custom columns and filters
- Scheduled reports

**Needs a design.** A report aggregates across records, so row visibility per caller must be enforced by the host or totals leak across units.

Planned: 0.2.28.

<a id="search"></a>

### Search and the command palette: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Data types that declare search are found by /api/search (host)

**Missing**

- Workspace records in search
- A custom search source
- Palette commands and actions
- Searching from a plugin

**Needs a design.** Results must be filtered by what the caller can see. The declarative path is safe; a free-form source needs host-side scoping.

Planned: 0.2.28.

**Missing**

- A settings page per plugin and per workspace

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="secrets"></a>

### Secrets: Partial

**In the SDK**

- PluginSecrets: encrypted per plugin and workspace (SDK 1.60)
- A host-rendered secret entry field that never returns the value (SDK 1.88)

**Missing**

- Listing and rotation

**Needs a design.** The host, not the caller, must decide which plugin and workspace a store belongs to.

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="files"></a>

### File storage: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Multipart uploads (SDK 1.5)
- PluginFiles and ready-made file routes (SDK 1.63)

**Missing**

- Signed temporary links
- Quotas and a scan hook
- file.uploaded event

**Needs a design.** The host must decide which plugin and workspace a store belongs to.

Planned: 0.2.28.

<a id="notifications"></a>

### Notifications and mail: Partial

**In the SDK**

- NotificationTransport contract (not yet discovered from plugins) (SDK 1.14)
- A Notifier service: send to a person, role or unit in the current workspace (SDK 1.90)
- Declared notification types with English and Arabic labels (SDK 1.90)
- A declared type can also go by email (emailDefault), following each person's preferences and the workspace's email switch (SDK 1.141)
- WorkspaceEmails host service: send an email as the workspace (its brand, language and the EM.1 layout) to anyone, such as a customer's invoice; plain text only, one button, best effort (SDK 1.100)
- BillingEmails host service: Whity's own email about a workspace's plan, in the instance's brand to its billing:pay members; only for a plugin that declares PluginBillingEmailsInterface and the operator granted, capped per workspace a day (SDK 1.102)

**Missing**

- Registering plugin transports
- Sent and failed events

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="messaging"></a>

### Messages and channels: Partial

**In the SDK**

- MessageChannel contract and PluginMessageChannelsInterface: add a channel such as WhatsApp or SMS (send, receive with the channel verifying the provider, delivery status, capabilities, templates) (SDK 1.97)
- Messaging\CustomerMessages host service: tell a workspace's customer something through Messages, trying channels in the plugin's order (WhatsApp, then email) (SDK 1.99)

**Missing**

- A host service for a plugin to read conversations
- Messages events (received, sent, failed)

**Needs a design.** A channel must verify every inbound request itself and act only for the workspace it is called for. The host never parses provider payloads and namespaces every plugin channel.

Planned: 0.2.28. Tracked in [#1803](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1803).

<a id="i18n"></a>

### Languages and translations: Partial

**In the SDK**

- English and Arabic labels on settings, data types, manifest screens and agents (SDK 1.21)
- The request's language on the SDK Request (SDK 1.87)
- Translatable content fields, shown by language on CRUD screens (SDK 1.93)

**Missing**

- Shipping a translation catalogue
- Arabic labels on frontend features, navigation and block text

Planned: 0.2.27. Tracked in [#521](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/521).

<a id="branding"></a>

### Branding and themes: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Theme token override from a plugin route (SDK 1.12)
- Ship theme files a workspace can choose (Contribute\PluginThemesInterface) (SDK 1.125)
- Read the workspace's compiled theme and the themes it can choose (Theme\WorkspaceTheme, from the context) (SDK 1.125)

**Missing**

- Reading the workspace logo and name
- Theme events (a workspace changed its theme)

**Needs a design.** Themes are data checked against a closed schema and the host runs the contrast guard rails on the result; no CSS reaches the page. Logos and names still need a design for a read API.

Planned: later.

<a id="navigation"></a>

### Navigation: Full

**In the SDK**

- Frontend features become sidebar items; navigation.register hook (SDK 1.2)

**Missing**

- Top bar, user menu and create quick actions
- Arabic labels

**Needs a design.** Navigation listeners receive the whole menu. Contributions should be append-only with links checked as internal paths.

Planned: 0.2.27.

- PluginDashboardInterface: setup points on Finish setting up, done by the plugin's own status route (SDK 1.115)
- Dashboard widgets (stat, list, chart, actions) built from blocks, several per plugin, with actions; people hide, move and resize them (SDK 1.115)
- Contributing to Waiting for you, through an inbox source (see Inbox and Waiting for you) (SDK 1.97)

Planned: 0.2.28.

- Reading the plugin's own audit entries (SDK 1.92)

- Status of the plugin's own jobs (SDK 1.91)

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="health"></a>

### Health and status: Full

**In the SDK**

**Missing**

Planned: later.

<a id="billing"></a>

### Plans, entitlements and payments: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Declared sellable limits in the plan catalogue (PluginEntitlementsInterface) (host)
- Selling store plugin licences through one billing plugin (LicenceSales, PluginLicenceSalesInterface) (SDK 1.86)
- Asking the host to re-read a workspace's billing access (AccessRefresh) (SDK 1.86)
- Read-only plan prices (PlanCatalogue) (SDK 1.84)
- Read-only plan prices (PlanCatalogue) (SDK 1.84)
- Usage\Usage: a workspace's usage meters for a month, read-only, with each base and warning state (SDK 1.133)
- Asking the host to re-read a workspace's billing access (AccessRefresh) (SDK 1.86)
- A plugin can be the deployment's billing portal: checkout, subscriptions, customer portal, refunds and verified provider notifications (PluginBillingPortalInterface) (SDK 1.77)
- Whether a paid Whity store plugin is licensed here: licensed, grace with an until date, or unlicensed, from the store's signed statement with a 7-day offline window (Licensing\StoreLicence) (SDK 1.85)
- Plugins sold per seat (getAccess seats) and QuantityCheckout for a checkout of several (SDK 1.110)
- TrialCheckout: take a card now and charge when a workspace's free trial ends (SDK 1.118)

**Missing**

- Reading entitlements and consuming meters through the SDK
- requiredEntitlement on routes
- Plan, subscription and seat events
- Charging through Whity Pay

**Needs a design.** Charging moves money. It needs consent, the ledger, idempotency and webhook trust; meters must stay bound to the workspace.

Planned: 0.2.28.

## Interface

<a id="plugin-screens"></a>

### Plugin screens and blocks: Full

**In the SDK**

- Frontend features (crud, action, custom) (SDK 1.2)
- @whity/plugin-sdk: the block contract generated from the PHP SDK, block types checked against it, a typed block builder, a client for the plugin's own routes, fetchAllPages, LocalizedText and test helpers, in a workspace package versioned with the SDK (SDK 1.165)
- The web app renders plugin screens with @whity/plugin-sdk's block types and walks pages with its walker, so plugins and the app read one contract (SDK 1.166)
- @whity/plugin-sdk is the one entry point for plugin frontends: the @whity/ui and @whity/features entry points nothing imports are marked internal, to leave at each package's next major (SDK 1.168)
- Server-driven blocks (SDK 1.6)
- Data blocks (SDK 1.7)
- chart block (SDK 1.10)
- Sort, filter and paging (SDK 1.11)
- Embedded screens (SDK 1.13)
- dataRecord and recordFields blocks (SDK 1.33)
- visibleWhen and accessGate (SDK 1.34)
- flow block (SDK 1.35)
- Labels and other visible text in English and Arabic ({en, ar}), served in the reader's language (SDK 1.101)
- PluginOnboardingInterface: a guided, step-by-step setup drawn by core as a stepper (SDK 1.109)
- Setup inputs: time, weekly hours, checkbox group, colour swatches, prefilled repeating rows (SDK 1.113)
- referenceSelect multiple: several rows from an API-backed source, shown as chips (SDK 1.121)
- Embedded screens call their own plugin's API through a message bridge (FrameBridge), with a five-minute token bound to the plugin's routes (SDK 1.150)
- Screens for a workspace's customers in their customer area at /@handle (a tab, a Home card or a page), on routes declared customer, with CustomerCall and CustomerIsolationTestCase (Contribute PluginCustomerScreensInterface) (SDK 1.174)

**Missing**

- Native screens for store plugins (custom screens need a change in this repository)

**Needs a design.** Embedded screens run in a sandboxed frame with no origin of their own (0.2.30). Since SDK 1.150 they reach the API only through the app's message bridge, with a short-lived token that works on their own plugin's routes alone. Native screens for store plugins still need a design.

Planned: later.

<a id="core-screen-slots"></a>

### Slots in core screens: None

**Missing**

- Tabs, sections and actions on person, user, role, unit, workspace and document record pages
- Slots in admin screens, settings and the person's own settings
- Top bar and user menu entries

**Needs a design.** A slot receives the record it sits on. It needs per-record permission checks and the same own-routes rule blocks have.

Planned: later.

<a id="desktop"></a>

### Desktop app: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Plugins run under the offline desktop PHP host (SDK 1.27)
- A plugin names the hardware it uses on the desktop (Contribute\PluginDesktopCapabilitiesInterface); the person sets each capability to Off, Ask first or Allowed on their device (SDK 1.167)

**Missing**

- Rendering plugin blocks in the desktop or Flutter apps
- Desktop plugin releases per workspace

Planned: later.

<a id="webhooks"></a>

### Outbound webhooks and connectors: Partial

**In the SDK**

- One outbound HTTP client for calling other servers: https only unless asked, verified TLS, no redirects, timeouts and a size cap, with recorded answers for tests (Http\Outbound\HttpClient, StreamHttpClient, Testing\RecordedHttpClient) (SDK 1.114)
- Response headers, and an opt-in policy that keeps a person-supplied URL off the server's own network: resolved once, every address public, connected to the checked address (HttpResponse::$headers, Http\Outbound\AddressPolicy) (SDK 1.122)

**Missing**

- Subscribing external URLs to events, with signing, retries and a delivery log
- Admin-registered connectors

**Needs a design.** Outbound calls to person-supplied URLs use AddressPolicy (1.122); webhooks still need signing secrets kept in PluginSecrets, a workspace check per event and id-only payloads.

## Plugin runtime

<a id="plugin-lifecycle"></a>

### Install, versions and lifecycle: Partial

**In the SDK**

- SDK version constraint (SDK 1.1)
- Core version constraint (SDK 1.4)
- PluginAccessInterface and PluginWorkspaceLifecycleInterface: paid plugins switched on per workspace, with trials, grace and read-only; WorkspaceAddons for billing plugins (SDK 1.107)
- SdkException: every exception the SDK defines shares one marker interface, so a plugin can catch whatever the host refused (SDK 1.123)
- PluginContext: one entry point to a plugin's settings, secrets, files, documents, notices, jobs, audit and outbound HTTP, in the workspace the call runs in; bound at the web, CLI and queue-worker entry points (SDK 1.124)
- PluginInstallLifecycleInterface: onInstalled and onUpgraded, once per version per deployment, after the plugin's migrations (SDK 1.152)
- sdk/CHANGELOG.md: what every SDK minor added, newest first, in one file a plugin author reads to pick a constraint (SDK 1.162)
- plugin.json declares settings, notifications, jobs, dashboard, onboarding, contact fields and themes, and whity-cli plugin validate checks a manifest offline before it is installed (SDK 1.163)

**Missing**

- The running core version

**Needs a design.** Installing and enabling stay operator-only. The installed and upgraded callbacks are told it happened, run with no workspace, and are given nothing that installs or enables a plugin.

Planned: 0.2.28.

<a id="observability"></a>

### Logging, errors and rate limits: Partial

**In the SDK**

- $ctx->log(): a plugin log scrubbed like the error tracker and tagged with the plugin and workspace by the host (SDK 1.152)
- $ctx->errors(): report a caught error to the deployment's error tracker, scrubbed and tagged (SDK 1.152)
- rateLimit on a plugin route: calls a minute per person (or address), answered with 429 before the handler runs (SDK 1.152)

**Missing**

- Metrics

**Needs a design.** Plugin log records and error reports pass through core's error scrubber before they are written or sent, and the plugin cannot set the plugin or workspace they are tagged with.

Planned: 0.2.28.

<a id="database"></a>

### Database and migrations: Full

**In the SDK**

- Migrations (SDK 1.0)
- Tenant-isolation conformance kit (SDK 1.3)
- SchemaInspector (SDK 1.23)
- Upsert and SequenceAllocator (SDK 1.25)
- Undeclared-reference linter (SDK 1.26)
- Offline-host conformance kit (SDK 1.27)
- $ctx->database(): the plugin's declared tables, every call held to the workspace by the host (WorkspaceTables) (SDK 1.151)
- PluginCapabilitiesInterface: a plugin declares the context services and tables it uses and gets only those (SDK 1.151)

**Missing**

- Read-only views of core tables

**Needs a design.** Since SDK 1.151 a plugin's own tables can be reached through a handle the host binds to the workspace, and a plugin that declares its services gets only those from its context. Plugin SQL written by hand is still checked by lint and tests, and plugin PHP runs in the host's process, so the declaration is least privilege, not a sandbox.

Planned: later.

<a id="http-routes"></a>

### HTTP routes: Full

**In the SDK**

- Request and Response (SDK 1.0)
- Multipart requests (SDK 1.5)
- Service routes: server-to-server calls with the trusted issuer's token, and the people they name (ServiceCall, LinkedPeople) (SDK 1.84)
- Route schemas in the OpenAPI document (host)
- Workspace, language and actor kind on Request (SDK 1.87)

**Missing**

- Per-route rate limits and entitlements

Planned: 0.2.27.

<a id="events"></a>

### Hook events: Partial

**In the SDK**

- Events catalogue (SDK 1.0)
- Veto exception (SDK 1.15)
- Observe-only listeners, a list of what each event lets a listener change, and constants for events core already fired (SDK 1.89)
- Hooks\EventCatalogue: each event's kind (observe, filter, veto, queued), documented payload keys, .async twin and the SDK minor it arrived in, readable at runtime and generated into HOOK_SYSTEM.md (SDK 1.164)

**Missing**

- Published constants for document.routed and document.route_acted
- Events for settings, plugins, plans, notifications, files and jobs

Planned: 0.2.27.

**Needs a design.** Commands run with full database rights outside RBAC. A plugin command must be operator-only and name its workspace explicitly.

- Reading the person's language, calendar and density
- Plugin preference keys

## Roadmap

Ordered by value to plugin authors, then by risk. Items marked design first get a reviewed design before any code.

**Hardening (0.2.27).** Before new surface: tighten the existing extension points the sweep found too permissive. Tracked privately under SECURITY.md and fixed in 0.2.27; each fix is listed here once it ships.

### 0.2.27: Events, context and the basics every plugin rebuilds

| Item | Areas | Value | Risk | Design first | Issue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Publish constants for every event core already fires, and add observe-only listeners | [Hook events](#events), [Invitations and registration](#invitations-registration), [Users and accounts](#users), [Documents](#documents) | high | low |  | [#1673](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1673) |
| form.submitted, submission.reviewed and submission.withdrawn, and issue events for submission documents | [Core forms and submissions](#core-forms), [Documents](#documents) | high | medium |  | [#1674](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1674) |
| Workspace, language and actor kind (person, agent, system) on the SDK Request | [HTTP routes](#http-routes), [Languages and translations](#i18n), [Personal preferences](#preferences) | high | low |  | [#1675](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1675) |
| Read and write the plugin's own settings for the current workspace, a settings-changed event, and a host-rendered secret field | [Settings](#settings), [Secrets](#secrets) | high | medium |  | [#1676](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1676) |
| Notifier: declared notification types, sent to a person, role or unit in the current workspace (shipped in SDK 1.90) | [Notifications and mail](#notifications) | high | medium |  | [#1677](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/1677) |
| Ship English and Arabic catalogues, and Arabic labels on features, navigation and blocks | [Languages and translations](#i18n), [Navigation](#navigation) | medium | low |  | [#521](https://github.com/whity-org/whity-core/issues/521) |
